title: Mathematical Audit and Operator Interfaces of Lo Shu Structures
summary: This paper organizes research on Lo Shu as a reproducible mathematical audit and a collection of operator interfaces. Its positive thesis is that the classification of numerical labels and the action of geometric operators must be defined separately and connected through explicit readouts, compressions, and error operators. The classification of order-three magic squares is established mathematics; we give self-contained proofs.
